name: Download & Use App from Play Store (HARD TASK)
instructions: Open Google Play Store on the Android phone. If a 'Complete account setup' or 'Add a payment option' gate appears, tap Skip to dismiss it. Then search for 'Google Keep' in the Play Store, install it, open Google Keep, create a new note with title 'VEXA Test Note' and body 'VEXA autonomous agent test successful', save the note, and report what you observed at each step.

name: Inspect Android Settings
instructions: Open Settings on the Android phone, check the Android version and Wi-Fi status, and report what you observe.

name: Calculator Math Task
instructions: Open the Calculator app on the Android device, compute 127 multiplied by 83, take a screenshot of the result, and report the exact number shown on screen.
